retainedPriorLocalConstraints.text: Propose a declared willing cohort including the caster and individually recorded companions; preserve 120-foot selection reach. Select no fixed participant cap and no hostile projection. Admission of unconscious, summoned, incorporeal or already projected recipients remains held with the actual body model; no automatic party/owner test.

Select conservation of one actor resource/history/action schedule as a proposed constraint; do not allocate a second RP, HP, rest, concentration or cast-history pool. Actual body-local damage/condition mapping remains unresolved.

Do not freeze or reset outside, Opening2400-hour, Horn1200-hour, rest or source-duration clocks. No Astral time conversion is selected; both elapsed timelines must be supplied before an encounter can be certified.

sequence: Choose actual class route and legally acquired known/prepared/spellbook entry; eligibility alone does not grant it. Current target remains unselectable pending review.
After a complete target/body model exists, preflight actual Action, V/S/F, source-qualified willing cohort, range/line of effect, fit and known blocks.
Determine real final cost from 26 base RP and exact current class/Dissonance rules; commit lawful costs and cast history before interruption. No invented material fee or refund.
Resolve only actual legal counters; no class feature or paid Action supplies the missing projection payload.
Apply a fully specified relation only after W01-W03; this return does not invent one. Maintain per-actor history, original clocks and custody through every later event.
